'''Irineu Esteve Altimiras'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Esteve|Altimiras}} (born 21 June 1996) is an Andorran [[Cross-country skiing (sport)|cross-country skier]] who competes internationally.<ref name="FISprofile">{{cite web |url=https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/athlete-biography.html?sectorcode=CC&competitorid=186291&type=result |title=Ireneu Esteve Altimiras |website=FIS-ski.com |publisher=International Ski and Snowboard Federation}}</ref>

He competed for Andorra at the [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2017]] in [[Lahti]], Finland.

All results are sourced from the [[International Ski Federation|International Ski Federation (FIS)]].<ref name="FISprofile" />
